[i]Effective immediately, New Westmore will be closing its embassy in Rosenmarkke and will be evacuating its diplomats out of the country. Air New Westmore, with assistance from Ansett Airlines and the Westmorian Air Force, will also be operating emergency repatriation flights to retrieve our citizens who are currently trapped inside the country. Any attack on our aircraft flying inside Rosenmarkket airspace will be considered as an attack on our country - we can and will retaliate if harm comes our way.

Their barbarity and brutality in this war cannot be understated, and we firmly believe that under ICJ law, they are committing war crimes inside Rosenmarkke. [b]second manned test for moon landing fails miserably[/b]
The second manned test for a moon landing was launched yesterday, March 27, 2028. While executing it's roll to safely exit Erene's atmosphere the rocket bursted into flames, instantly killing all 4 onboard. This disaster has sparked much media pushback at such a fast pace. John Fredrickson spoke to the press saying that numbers were greatly exaggerated and that we will most likely on be able to reach the moon by the mid 2040s. Currently the main thinking is that a loose panel on the capsule had hit the fuel tank of the Traja-IX and caused it to explode, but further investigation is needed.

[b]March 12, 2028: A funeral! Oh what a funeral![/b]

Polenne Strømm had been controversial in life, but in death, she had become immortal.

Following the Council of 99 confirming her death, the international distribution of the autopsy photos, showing the gruesome remains of the former chief consul, and the formal handing over of the authority of the executive to the Council of 99, the government would announce a national funeral for her, calling on all citizens to take part.

Thus on March 12, 2028 on what was supposed to have been her 44th birthday, two hundred seventeen thousand people crammed into the streets to watch the coffin ceremony.

To start the ceremony the bells of Tharkønn would be rung, their solemn tones echoing in the air, weeping could be heard across the city as the helicopter which held her casket landed on the grand avenue which ran from the seaside four miles to the national cathedral.

As the coffin was placed on the horse drawn bier, and the national anthem played, the television cameras began to film.

Families dressed in black lined the avenue, clutching their children close to them, college students peered curiously at the coffin as it passed by. 

As the coffin reached the large triumphal arch that sat in the middle of a roundabout, the procession went beneath it, breaking 200 years of tradition. Beneath the arch her nephews and family would join the crowd of government officials that had joined to follow the coffin, some reaching out to touch the flag of their leader, to grasp the last tangible visible part of the woman who had led them and promised the restoration of Rosenmarkke.

After the thirty minute procession they arrived at the cathedral, mounted the steps, and disappeared within as orthodox monks chanted hymns of glory in the echoing church.

The service was shorter than most, and it wasnt televised, however an hour later the coffin reappeared and was loaded onto the bier to head back down the avenue towards the ocean, where a large silver barge waited to take the coffin to a special resting place in the Cemetery of the National Heroes.

As the coffin was loaded onto the barge a wail went up from Strømms elderly mother with dementia who suddenly remembered her daughter while looking at the coffin. The wailing and weeping spread, echoing through the streets as even those who opposed her wept, clutching one another.

[b]2028/3/28: Keagson Kent Moves In[/b]

Two years ago, the WMW Companys factories and offices near Wichenvidence were attacked in a string of terrorist attacks by GuhuiBernardio, leading to its destruction and abandonment. Shortly after abandonment, Lamandican-owned military-manufacturing company Keagson Kent announced that it would take control of the property, working to restore and rebuild for the duration of this time.

Today, Keagson Kent opens their new state-of-the-art campus, with future expansions to the campus being planned. Today, one of the most productive military manufacturing sites reopens as Keagson Kent Odrenisus.

[b]March 13, 2028: As the world turns[/b]
The tea which sat before the shah lay cold, across from him the usually vivacious Cahit Alparslan sat with a deep scowl across his face, a stress ball clenched in his fist. Edis sat next to the shah, his lips held tightly together, in his hand a communique.
So the decap strikes, they were successful, stated the shah coldly.
Yes, apparently wiped out the Rosenmarkket leadership, thoughrumors have begun to flow,
Ah d-mn the rumors, best to keep them that way! Said Cahit with a wave of his hand.
The shah sighed, It was an ally of Wuloosya right? He asked Edis.
Yes, replied Edis.
New Westmore apparently has called for, what is itboycotts and sanctions against the Hochdeutsche Konfederation, whose expeditionary forces were authorized to carry out the strikes, said Cahit, placing the stress ball on the table with a cough.
Gentlemen, the situation has become untenable, prices are rising because of this war in Elseyr, replied the shah, standing up and beginning to walk aimlessly around the courtyard, looking at the flowers.
Yes, there is no doubt, replied Edis.
The reckless actions of Wuloosya have affected trade through the White Sea, said the shah.
Correct, intoned Cahit.
Then we shall do what is right, intoned the shah, We shall remain neutral in this conflict if only for stability, but we can profit in our sale of oil to countries that might be affected by disruptions of the Rosenmarkket Ardavour oil, I believe they do trade with Lamandica and New Westmore for oil? Continued the shah.
So cold, so cunning, chortled Cahit.
And what of Wuloosya, we do oil with them as well, asked Edis.
Yes that is the rub is it not, replied the shah thoughtfully, And that will have to wait and see, for now, our stability triumphs over alliance and enemy, said the shah, nodding and then leaving the garden.

Given the abnormal and absurd events that have transpired lately, going as far as a deception strike on a world leader, the Commonwealth has begun to begin operating in mass discretion all agents and diplomatic channels across Erene.

Meanwhile, the military and intelligence services have been put to full alert, and have begun convening with other allied militaries and intelligences on matters of counterterrorism and world peace, as units and assets are being moved within and without Vespurias.

Defensive preparedness as well as an immediate meeting of the VHC in Hyperion shall commence forthwith, alongside meetings between Cabinet and the Vespurian Ethics Committee. Further contacts and discussion are to occur across the International Forum and International Court of Justice channels and connections.

The Commonwealth assures this is a thoroughly natural and genuine diplomatic and peace intended movement to all allies and trustworthy nations. For Hope and Glory.

Today, following the condemnations of the Neue Republik and the United Commonwealth of Wuloosya, the ULR has officially followed its fellow West Argos neighbors in condemning the two warring nations. In a video released to the public by President Achebes administration, the president said: 

In the past few days, the Neue Republic and Wuloosya have not only declared war over a frivolous reason, but have also murdered our close ally and Rossenmarke political leader Polenne Strømm. This outright carelessness from not only a singular state, but from one who claims to be upon the top economies and militaries in Elyser, if not on Erene, is a disgusting display of thoughtlessness one could only compare to a primal animal or neanderthal with no higher cognitive functions than anger and bloodthirst. If other members of the EDU and the world have any sense of right, they will see this monstrous display for what it is: Defiance of international law and consequence itself.

This is a war started by career politicians and children of nepotism. I have participated in these barbaric practices myself, as the scars on my chest from bullets and this old beret on my head are evidence of. There is no glamour in war like movies might show you or idiots might gloat about, there is only destruction, death, and the carelessness of which those who have never seen war send children to die. I hate war as only a soldier who has lived it can, only as one who has seen its brutality, its futility, its stupidity. I cannot state how saddened I am at the state of this world. These nations are nothing but bullies, killing and doing as they please. A bully must be shown the fist, and the fist we shall show them.

Independent news sources as well as many people on social media have noticed increased security around military installations and a large callup of the National Guard, marking speculation round involvement in this war. The government has also announced that it will be evacuating all citizens of Five-Eye Pact members, as well as partnering with New Westmore to increase the frequency of evacuation flights and coordinate the return of nationals to their countries. This is also paired with a single statement from the SNOC stating: We are now at STRADS (Strategic Readiness And Defense Standby) level 3 (nicknamed "Developing Storm"). Lavias nuclear triad is prepared and ready. We recommend citizens inform themselves of the closest storm or natural disaster shelter to them.
